cc:Work.dc:title: Labelled holonomy kernel patching
cc:Work.dc:description:
EG.5-EG.8, EK.2-EK.5. Features have the exact listed coordinates; their positions are numerical renderings. Arrow and control panels are typed schematics.
# Component terms
The original EG.1–EG.9 and EK.1–EK.6 derivations, theorem, 32-point solved exercises, exact finite-check mechanisms, diagram coordinates and reproduction source are dedicated to CC0 1.0. No historical priority is claimed for Molino theory, Lie development, coarse embeddings or positive-kernel transfer. Ordinary theorem inputs are credited at their precise scopes in the text. The [complete CC0 dedication](../labelled-geometric-kernel/LICENSE-CC0.txt) accompanies the shared course resources. Full Python, Matplotlib, NumPy and Pillow notices are retained in `../labelled-geometric-kernel/software-notices/`. No protected primary-source prose is imported into the mathematical payload.
The diagram uses the installed, unchanged DejaVu Sans font; no font binary or runtime library is distributed. Its full unchanged Bitstream/DejaVu/Arev notice follows and is embedded in the PNG description and SVG metadata. Python, Matplotlib, NumPy and Pillow are separately installed runtime dependencies, with their own distributed notices. Reproduction uses Python 3.13.9, Matplotlib 3.10.9, NumPy 2.4.4 and Pillow 12.2.0; checks-only mode uses the Python standard library.
